unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 车轮, 轮子；汽车 `v.` 旋转、转动, 盘旋
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The wheels on the bus go round and round.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wheel（车轮）滚动时发出“微——”(wiːl)的声音。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 什么时候；当时, 当场；什么情况下 `pron.` 何时, 什么 `conj.` 当……时, 一……时候
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: When?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: w（我）+ hen（母鸡）“什么时候”下蛋？

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `conj.` 每当, 无论何时, 每次 `adv.` 究竟什么时候
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I remember my grandmother whenever I smell cinnamon.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: when(什么时候)+ever(曾经/无论)：无论什么时候，每当。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `conj.` (表迟疑或两个可能性之间的选择)是否
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I wonder whether it will be sunny tomorrow.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：whether or not 是否。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron. & det.` 哪一个, 哪一些；……的那些
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Which words have 'z' or 'l' sounds?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“位置”。在捉迷藏时你问我：你想藏在“哪一个”位置？发音同witch（女巫），是在问“哪一个才是真女巫？”

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `conj.` 与……同时, 虽然, 在……期间, 当……的时候 `n.` 一段时间 `v.` 消磨, 轻松度过
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: After dinner, he usually plays the guitar for a while.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 一会儿，while。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 整个, 全部, 所有, 统一体 `adj.` 整个的, 整体的, 全部的, 完全的 `adv.` 全新的, 完全不同
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I spent the whole day in my room, but I did not write a single card!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 我的整个(whole)身体掉进了大洞(hole)里。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 谁
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Celebrating my birthday: When, What to prepare, Where to go, With whom, What to do, How I feel.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: who的宾格形式，用来询问动作的对象“谁”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det. & pron.` (用于问句)谁的；那个人的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Whose schoolbag is left on the desk?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：whose book 谁的书。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 为什么, ……的原因 `int.` 哎呀 `n.` 原因, 理由
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Why do Taotao and Jiajia get up early?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法 (外 - 为什么要跑去外面)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 宽的, 广泛的, 大量的, 很大的 `adv.` 尽可能远地 `n.` (板球或棒球)坏球
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The government has built thousands of kilometres of highways, railways, and wide roads.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 宽阔的(wide)马路两旁很狂野(wild)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 广泛地, 很大程度上, 普遍的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: English is widely spoken in many countries around the world.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：wide (宽) + ly (副词后缀) -> 广泛地。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 妻子
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: When his wife went a long way to send meals...
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: w(我)+ife(类似life生活)：我的妻子是我生活的一部分。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 野生的, 天然的, 盲目的, 狂暴的 `n.` 自然环境, 野生状态
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Pandas live in the wild bamboo forests of Sichuan.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：wild animals 野生动物。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `modal verb.` 将, 愿, 要, 劳烦别人做事时用 `v.` 想要, 希望, 愿意 `n.` 意志, 毅力, 意愿, 心愿, 遗嘱
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We will have a sports meeting next Friday.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：strong will 坚强的意志。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 赢, 夺取, 获得, 获胜 `n.` 胜利
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Our team played hard and managed to win the match.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：win first prize 获得一等奖。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 风, 气流 `v.` 卷绕, 缠绕, 蜿蜒
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The wind blows around, around, around.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：win(赢)+d(的) -> 赢得胜利，风(wind)在呼啸庆祝。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 窗, 窗口, 窗户；视窗
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The teacher's next to the window.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 赢(win)得(dow)窗户

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 多风的, 风大的；夸夸其谈的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It's windy, windy, windy.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：wind(风)+y(形容词后缀) -> 风很大，就是风大的(windy)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 翼, 派；机翼；侧面 `v.` 飞, 飞行
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It has the most colourful wings.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 把戒指 (ring) 戴在鸟儿的翅膀 (wing) 上。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 优胜者, 获胜的人
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You're the real winner!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: win (赢) + ner (人) = 赢的人，即获胜者。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 冬天, 冬季 `v.` 过冬
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here comes winter.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：win（赢）+ ter（特）= 冬天很冷，坚持锻炼的“特”别容易“赢”

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 明智的, 英明的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Was the farmer wise?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 想要win赢就要很**明智的**。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 希望, 祝, 想要, 企求 `n.` 希望, 愿望, 祝愿, 祝福
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is Yanyan's birthday wish?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wish（愿望）：W（我）+ ish（爱死）——我爱死这个愿望了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `prep.` 具有, 和, 跟；与；关于 `adv.` 在内部, 在里面
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I like reading books with lots of colourful pictures.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：play with 和……玩；with a smile 面带微笑。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `prep.` 没有, 不用, 不带, 缺乏 `adv.` 没有, 缺乏
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We Can't Live Without Bees
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词: with (和...一起) + out (在外面) -> 没有，缺乏。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (`pl.` wolves) 狼
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A baby wolf and its mother!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆法: 狼 (wolf) 在高尔夫 (golf) 球场上奔跑。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 想知道, 琢磨, 想弄明白 `n.` 奇迹, 奇观；惊奇；奇才
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There are so many wonders on earth.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: won（赢）+ der（德）-> 赢得奇迹般的胜利

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 精彩的, 绝妙的, 令人惊奇的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You're a wonderful friend.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wonder(奇迹) + ful(充满的) = 了不起的

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 木, 木头, 木料；树林
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This strong desk is made of solid wood.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：wood (木头) vs wooden (木制的)。
